## Marti Technologies Expands Ride-Hailing Service to 40 Cities Across Türkiye


October 28, 2026 6:30am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_a486f3d264397dc08280fbea03ab901b/marti/news/2026-10-28_Marti_Technologies_Expands_Ride_Hailing_Service_119.pdf)


*Launches in 10 Additional Cities, Expanding Service Coverage to Markets Representing Approximately 90% of Türkiye’s GDP*


ISTANBUL--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Marti Technologies, Inc. (“Marti” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: MRT), Türkiye’s leading mobility super app, **today announced the launch of its ride-hailing service in 10 additional cities across Türkiye** , bringing its **ride-hailing footprint to 40 cities and expanding its reach to markets representing approximately 90% of Türkiye’s GDP** .


The latest expansion builds on the Company’s continued growth beyond Istanbul, including the launch of service in 10 new cities in August 2026. The share of Marti’s **ride-hailing** **riders located outside of Istanbul reached 47% as of October 27, 2026** , **up from 36% as of October 27, 2025** . Over the same period, the share of Marti’s **registered drivers based outside of Istanbul grew from 28% to 38%** .


“Just a few months ago, **Marti’s ride-hailing service** was available **in 20 cities** . Today, we are **in 40** ,” said Oguz Alper Oktem, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Marti. “Doubling our footprint in such a short period **demonstrates our ability to scale our platform** and the **strength of our field operations** . Each new city expands our addressable market and brings us closer to our goal of extending the reach of Marti to more consumers across the country.”


The 10 new cities are **Afyonkarahisar, Aksaray, Batman, Bolu, Diyarbakır, Isparta, Kütahya, Malatya, Mardin, and Nevşehir** . Marti selected these markets based on demonstrated **ride-hailing demand** and **limited availability of substitute transportation options** .


Marti entered the ride-hailing market **** in 2022. Following this latest expansion, its ride-hailing service now reaches markets representing **approximately 90% of Türkiye’s GDP** , up **from approximately 85% previously. The expanded footprint represents another significant step toward Marti’s long-term objective of building a nationwide ride-hailing network.**


**Marti reaffirms its previously announced fiscal year 2026 financial guidance of $85 million in revenue and $7 million in Adjusted EBITDA. The Company expects the new city launches to be accretive to its financial performance starting in 2028.**


**About Marti:**


Founded in 2018, Marti is Türkiye’s leading mobility app, offering a wide variety of transportation services. Marti operates a ride-hailing service that matches riders with car, motorcycle, and taxi drivers; offers delivery services; and operates a large fleet of rental e-mopeds, e-bikes, and e-scooters. All of Marti’s offerings are serviced by proprietary software systems and IoT infrastructure. For more information, visit[www.marti.tech](http://www.marti.tech/) .
